title: A little space by the window
subtitle: A desk, a mint plant, and a small daily ritual.
body:
On Saturday, I moved a stack of books from the desk back to the shelf. The space they left was just big enough for a glass of water and a small pot of mint.

Now, before opening my laptop, I check the soil. While watering the plant, I take the glass to the kitchen. It takes a minute or two, and has lasted longer than my plan to keep the whole room tidy.

Make a little room for something easy to begin. The rest can follow in its own time. Today, this one corner is enough to look after.

A few days later, I notice a new leaf has opened. I had almost forgotten it was there.
highlights: Make a little room for something easy to begin.
